title: GitHub - JustDashboard/Just-Dashboard
excerpt: Contribute to JustDashboard/Just-Dashboard development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Your whole Linux server, in one private control panel.

Deploy apps, run Docker, manage databases, shape the network, open a real shell and keep it all backed up, behind one login that lives on your private network.

Version 0.8.5 · Free and self-hosted · AGPL-3.0

What it does

Just Dashboard is one control panel for one Linux server. It deploys your apps, runs your containers and databases, manages the network, proxy and certificates, and gives you a real terminal, files and Git in the browser. It needs no fleet, no cloud account and no paid tier: every feature is free and stays free. See every feature →

Install

You need a Linux server you have root on.

git clone https://github.com/JustDashboard/Just-Dashboard.git
cd Just-Dashboard && sudo ./install.sh

The installer asks how you will reach the dashboard, then does the rest and prints how to get in:

  • Tailscale (default): the machine stays invisible to the internet, and the dashboard answers at https://your-box.tailnet-name.ts.net:8443 with a real certificate.
  • SSH tunnel: the dashboard is served on loopback only.

Upgrade with Update now in the dashboard. Everything about installing →

Contributing How to work on the project

Who builds this

Just Dashboard is built by one person, Wayy01, under the JustDashboard organisation.

If it has saved you an evening, you can buy me a coffee. It is entirely optional.

Sponsors and investors

None yet, so this space is open. To sponsor or invest in the project, write to ionmoisei755@gmail.com. Sponsors are listed here with a logo and a link.

AGPL-3.0. Run it, change it and distribute it, but if you run a modified version as a network service, publish your changes. The product logos bundled in frontend/public/logos/ are their owners' trademarks and keep their own licences, listed in that directory's NOTICE.
